title: Dynamic Clouds
description: Minecrafty, performant, stylish voxel clouds made with inspiration from real clouds
body:
# Dynamic Clouds

**Vanilla's flat, boring clouds, reimagined into Minecraft-fitting voxels.**

Dynamic Clouds replaces Minecraft's paper-thin cloud plane with **real, volumetric clouds built from voxels** — fluffy cumulus, towering storm fronts, and high wispy cirrus that drift across the sky. They're made of voxels, so they belong in your world… they just happen to be _huge_ and _alive_.

The sky stops being a static backdrop. A clear afternoon slowly clouds over, the wind picks up as a storm rolls in, lightning flickers through a churning grey ceiling overhead, and if you climb _above_ it all, you break out into calm sunshine.

## ☁️ Features

- **Volumetric clouds** — layered cloud types stacked into real-looking skies, never a flat sheet.
- **Living weather** — the sky moves through its own moods: _clear_, _cloudy_, _rainy_, dramatic _storms_, and the rare, ferocious **Orcan** — a hurricane-grade tempest.
- **Wind** — clouds drift on the breeze, and it strengthens and howls as the weather turns.
- **Cloud shadows** — clouds cast soft shadows on the ground on brighter days.
- **Terrain-aware clouds** — they flow _around_ and _over_ mountains instead of slicing through them.
- **Storm atmosphere** — darkness and fog gather beneath storm clouds, lightning lights up the underside, and thunder rumbles. Fly above the deck and it's clear and sunny up there.
- **Endless sky** — clouds reach all the way to the horizon.

## ⚙️ Settings

Everything is adjustable in-game through Mod Menu:

**General**
- **Enable Dynamic Clouds** — master switch; off returns you to vanilla clouds.
- **Cloud distance** — how far the clouds render out.
- **Smooth transitions** — gently fade between weather instead of snapping.

**Cloud Shadows**
- **Cloud shadows** — toggle shadows on the ground.
- **Shadow strength** — how dark they fall.

**Weather**
- **Enable weather** — let the mod run its own sky moods (turn off for clouds without the drama).
- **Above clouds is clear** — stay in sunshine when you fly over a storm.
- **Weather fog** — the gloom and haze under bad weather, with adjustable _density_.

**Wind**
- **Wind sounds** — the howl that rises during storms.
- **Flight turbulence** _(single-player)_ — let storms buffet your elytra around, with adjustable _strength_ — or switch it off for steady flight.

**Terrain**
- **Terrain interaction** — let clouds bend around hills and mountains.
- **Max push** — how far terrain can nudge a cloud aside.

## 📦 Dependencies

- **Fabric Loader** and **Fabric API** — _required_.
- **Mod Menu** + **YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)** — for the in-game settings screen.

Dynamic Clouds is a **client-side** mod: install it on your client and it works on _any_ server, vanilla or modded — nothing to install server-side.

## ✅ Compatibility

- Plays nicely with **Distant Horizons** and **Voxy** — the clouds stretch out over your distant terrain.
- Needs a reasonably modern graphics card (anything from roughly the last decade). _Not currently supported on macOS as GL 4.6 is needed_
